description: Search the Vargov®Design catalogue: 605 made-to-order light and decorative compositions, codes LC0001…LC0602. Full-text over codes, type labels and the brand's own texts (description, where it works, style) in Russian and English; other site languages are matched too. Filters: family (lighting | decorative | sculptural-decor | floor-table-lamps); lit (true = the lighting family or a type label mentioning light/lamp/backlit — a hint derived from labels, not a measured property); awarded (has a listed award); configurable (opens in the 3D configurator with a full calculation: IFC4, FBX, PDF specification, tender sheet — 360 of 605). Returns compact rows: code, names RU/EN, family, type, flags, site pages, cover image, English snippet. Then use get_composition for details and build_configurator_link to open the configurator with the room plan. No prices, materials or composition dimensions are published.

configurable.description: true: opens in the configurator with a full calculation (IFC4/FBX/PDF/tender sheet)

lit.description: true: light-emitting (hint from labels); false: decorative/unlit

query.description: Words or a code, e.g. "hotel lobby", "birds", "гостиная", "LC0564"
